text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
{0} and Yukari are sitting at a table
in their usual restaurant.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いつもの飲食店で、
{0}とユカリはテーブルを囲んでいた。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Hahaaaweeee!
Thish barley broth tashtes real good todayyy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うひゃっは～い！
きょ～も麦しゅわが
おいし～わね～！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you aren't drinking, are ya?
Hmmm? Oh, itsh jusht juice.
Good boy. You're shtill not big enough for barley broth!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん～
飲んでる～？
あ～、
それジュースね～？
うんうん、
キミにはまだ麦しゅわは早いからね～！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
What?! Barley broth ish barley broth!
If ya gggulp it down, it'sh all fizzy and smooth
in your throat and shtuff.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え～？　
麦しゅわは麦しゅわよぉ～？
ぐい～
っと飲むと
しゅわしゅわ～
ってしてぇ、
ふわふわ～
ってにゃる飲み物！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Shmellsh amazing right?
If ya give it a good whiff, you'll shtart to feel reeeal gooood. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
いい香りでしょ～
この香りを嗅ぐと、
と～
ってもいい気分になるのよぅ～♪

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Huh? That face tellsh me ya want a sssip.
But you can't! Thish ish a grown-ups only flavor, you shee? ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～、
しょの顔は興味がありゅって顔だな～？
でもダメよぉ～？　
これは
オ
・
ト
・
ナ
の味にゃんらから～♪

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I wassh right, you know. Drinking with you feelsh great. ♪
The barley broth tashtes... like a thousand times better! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
うふふ。
やっぱり{0}くんと飲むと気分がいいわぁ～♪
麦しゅわも
いつもの倍……
ううん、
500倍はおいしいわ～♪

text_block_list.name: Owner
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, slow down, miss!
Don't you think you've had a little too much?
Can you even stand up?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっとちょっとお客さん、
飲み過ぎじゃないの？
フラフラじゃないか。

text_block_list.name: Owner
text_block_list.text:
Please don't cause a nuisance to the other patrons.
There are people trying to trade tools here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほかのお客さんの迷惑にならないように頼むよ？
道具の商談とかやってる人もいるんだからさ。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
I don't shee a porblem!
I'm not even tipshy—
text_block_list.orig_text:
だぁいじょ～ぶよぉ！
こんりゃのいつもにょ──

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Whaa?
text_block_list.orig_text: はにゃ？

text_block_list.name: Owner
text_block_list.text: Ugh... What did I tell you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～……
言わんこっちゃない。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Waahh! Hyeaargh?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わっ、
ひゃっ～！？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
...Urk. Ow, ow, ow...
Huh...?
{0}, why did you jump on me...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ん、
イタタ……
え……？
{0}くん、
どうして私に、覆いかぶさって……？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Were you protecting me...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしかして、
私をかばって……？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: N-no...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うん……

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
He just risked his life to protect me...
H-his face is too close, too close, too close...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まさか、
身を挺して私をかばってくれるなんて……
か、
顔近い顔近い
顔近い……！

text_block_list.name: Merchant
text_block_list.text: Hey you, are you all right?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そこの君、
大丈夫だったかい！？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Are you the guy whose seat I bumped into...?
I'm so sorry I flipped your table...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
私がぶつかっちゃった席の……？
ごめんなさい、
テーブルの上ひっくり返しちゃって……

text_block_list.name: Merchant
text_block_list.text:
Uh... Actually, I'm more worried about him!
When he jumped up to protect you, he was hit by an anti-criminal magic device!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
それはまぁいいんだけど、
そっちの彼だよ！
かばった時に、
防犯用の魔道具に当たっちゃっただろう！？

text_block_list.name: Merchant
text_block_list.text:
This thing temporarily restricts its target's movements.
Whatever part of you it hit won't be able to move for a while...
text_block_list.orig_text:
こいつは
一時的に相手の動きを縛る道具でね、
これに当たった部分は
しばらく動かなくなるんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Really?!
I'm so sorry! It's all my fault...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ、
そうなの！？
ご、
ごめんね、
私のせいで……！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: It's no problem...? Of course it's a problem!
text_block_list.orig_text:
問題ないって……
そんなわけないじゃない。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, today you're coming to my place.
Let me take care of the things you need your hand for.
text_block_list.orig_text:
とりあえず今日はうちにいらっしゃい。
手が使えない分、
私にお世話させて？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: All right, open wide.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
あーん。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Well, how is it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どう、
美味しい？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
We had to suddenly leave the tavern
because I caused a scene and made a mess. We didn't get to finish our meal, did we?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お店に迷惑かけたのが申し訳なくて
急いで出てきちゃったけど、
ご飯の途中だったのよね。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
I only used what I had on hand,
so it turned out to be just a simple stir-fry,
but I hope you like it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありもので作ったから
簡単な炒め物になっちゃったけど、
口に合うかしら？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
It's good? Better than last time?
...Oh, you remember when I hosted you before.
But it was a total mess back then. This time is different.
text_block_list.orig_text:
美味しい？　
前のよりも？
……
覚えててくれたのね、
おもてなしの時のこと。
あの時はグダグダだったけど、
今日は失敗しなかったわよ。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
You know, it's not like everything I do is a failure.
It's just... when you're around, I get a little distracted, is all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私だって
いつも失敗してるわけじゃないのよ？
その……
キミがいると、
何だか油断しちゃうだけで。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
You've... seen everything, haven't you?
All my bad points, that is.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんにはその……
全部見られちゃってるからね。
私のダメなところ。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Eheheh. Next bite—open up!
Oh, let me blow on it to cool it down for you first. ♪
choice_data_list: I can eat with my left hand.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ。
ほら次、
口を開けて？
ちゃんと
ふーふーして、冷ましてあげるから♪

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
What's this? Are you embarrassed?
You'll just have to deal with it. You'd make a mess with your left hand.
text_block_list.orig_text:
何？　
もしかして照れてるの？
でも我慢してね。
左手だとポロポロこぼしちゃうでしょ。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Here you go. Be careful now, it's still a bit hot.
Oh, you got some on your face. Let me wipe it off for you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
やけどしないようにね。
あ、
口元が汚れてる。
拭いてあげるわね。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, even though it was all unintentional...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういえば、
何気なくやってたけど……

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Not only have I brought him home with me,
but I'll have to take care of him too, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
これって、
私が彼のことをお持ち帰りした上に、
これからいろんなお世話をするってことよね？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Wh-what should I do? This situation is totally like—!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どどど、
どうしよう、
これってまるで……！？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
T-take it easy, Yukari.
It's all because I caused a nuisance...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
落ち着くのよユカリ。
これは私が迷惑をかけちゃったから……！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Somehow you're managing to stay calm, aren't you?
Even though I'm all in a fluster.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ていうかキミ、
何だかすごく落ち着いてるわよね？
お姉さんがこんなに慌ててるのに。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You're used to it?
Being fed?
...Being taken care of?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
慣れてる？
食べさせてもらうのに？
……お世話されるのも？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Could it be a normal thing that everybody does?
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしかしてこれって、
誰でもやってる普通のことだったの……？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: But... again, I'm sorry.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも……
改めてごめんね。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
To think I got too drunk and caused you a lot of trouble.
I'm such a failure...
choice_data_list: You didn't cause me any trouble at all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
飲み過ぎて{0}くんに迷惑かけちゃうなんて、
お姉さん失格よね……

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: *sigh* There you go again, saying kind things!
text_block_list.orig_text:
う～、
キミはまたそうやって優しいことを言うんだから！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
But it's no use! For once I can't forgive myself!
Therefore.... I've made up my mind!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもダメ！　
今回ばかりは
私が私を許せないの！
だから私……
決めたわ！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: I'm... giving up barley broth!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私──
麦しゅわやめる！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wh-what's with that face?!
Don't you think I have it in me?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
な、
何その反応！？
絶対無理だって顔してない！？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: I-I'm definitely gonna quit!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぜ、
絶対やめるんだから！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Henceforth, I, Yukari, am under a barley broth ban... No, that's too long.
Barley ban. Still not quite right.
How about... broth ban!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この度私、
ユカリは、
禁麦しゅわ……
ちょっと長いか。
禁麦、
は何か違うわね。
じゃあ……
禁しゅわ！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: I am under a broth ban!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私──
禁しゅわします！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Yukari's sonorous declaration
of self-enforced barley broth prohibition
echoed through the still night.
text_block_list.orig_text:
物静かな夜、
ユカリの禁しゅわ宣言が高らかに響くのであった。
